client.business_model: Multi-site women’s health platform operating OB/GYN clinics, ancillary services and telehealth offerings across multiple U.S. states
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 by Sean Glass, Advantia Health has grown through acquisitions such as Heartland Women’s Healthcare and the Pacify tele-lactation app. A $45 million growth investment from BlueMountain Capital Management in 2020 is fueling national expansion and technology integration.

revenue.notes: Public sources disagree widely: Zippia ≈$13 M, Buzzfile ≈$29 M, Growjo ≈$22.4 M, CanvasBusinessModel ≈$89 M (2024 projection). No audited or company-reported number located. Used midpoint (Growjo) but confidence is low due to large variance.

locations.source: Company website locations page (https://www.advantiahealth.com/locations) cross-checked with 2019 Heartland acquisition PR (PRNewswire 02-2019)
locations.notes: Website lists more than 45 individual practice sites across MD, VA, DC, IL and MO; Heartland acquisition press release referenced 25 Mid-West locations in addition to Mid-Atlantic sites. Rounded to ~50 total active clinic locations.

employees.source: LeadIQ company profile (December 2025) and SignalHire range
employees.notes: LeadIQ lists ≈501 staff; SignalHire gives 500-1,000; Buzzfile shows 259 which appears outdated (mid-2021). Chose 500 to reflect most recent consensus.
